identity.styleSentence: A slow-burning, hypnotic 123 BPM track with heavy 808s, eerie soul chords, and ghostly vocal chops, creating a late-night, insomnia-induced atmosphere with a narcotic groove and cinematic underground club feel.
identity.summary: The song 'Drink Drink [Don't Save Me]' by xsytrance explores themes of self-destruction, emotional numbness, and the struggle to escape inner turmoil, wrapped in a hypnotic, dark hip-hop and R&B atmosphere.
